title: Tip from Angela - How to Solidify Your Knowledge
summary: Study tip: explaining concepts to others and inventing your own analogies turns working-but-fuzzy understanding into durable knowledge.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Code that merely runs can hide gaps. Having to explain why it works, or why one approach beats another, exposes what is not yet understood and prompts further reading.
Putting an idea into words (spoken or written) forces recall and fixes it in memory.
Once a concept is clear, devise personal analogies for it rather than relying only on the course's.
Share explanations and analogies with other learners in the course Q&A; a different framing may help someone else.
Regularly try to explain what you have learned to another person.
